lines.text: David takes refuge in God and finds all his delight in the saints in the land.
Sorrows multiply for those who chase other gods, and David will not pour out their libations of wine.
David says the LORD is his chosen portion and his cup, and his boundary lines fell in pleasant places.
David blesses the LORD who counsels him, and with the LORD at his right hand he will not be shaken.
God will not abandon David's soul to Sheol, and He has made known to him the path of peace.
